entities.summary: Berni Searle is an artist who works with photography, video, and film to produce lens-based installations that stage narratives connected to history, identity, memory, and place. Often politically and socially engaged, her work also draws on universal emotions associated with vulnerability, loss and beauty. Berni Searle was a painters & sculptors from Cape Town (b. 1964-07-07, Cape Town). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
